description: This file defines a DeepLinks handler for a macOS application, including URL parsing, validation, and agent invocation logic with logging, user prompts, and security considerations.

classes.name: DeepLinkHandler
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for handling deep links from URLs, managing agent communication, validation, and user prompts within the application.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point to process incoming URLs asynchronously to trigger appropriate agent actions.

methods.name: handleAgent
methods.description: Processes agent deep link requests, performing validation, user confirmation, and dispatching messages through the gateway.

methods.name: currentKey
methods.description: Returns the current expected deep link key.

methods.name: currentCanvasKey
methods.description: Returns the dynamically generated in-memory key for unattended deep links from the Canvas.

methods.name: expectedKey
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the stored deep link key, saving it in UserDefaults if necessary.

methods.name: generateRandomKey
methods.description: Creates a new cryptographically secure random key for deep links.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Displays a confirmation alert with Yes/No options and returns the user's choice.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays an informational alert with an OK button.
